title: Chapter 92: Killing The Trickster On The Battlefield And Winning The Hearts Of The People
content:
Chapter 92: Killing The Trickster On The Battlefield And Winning The Hearts Of The People

Seeing a large group of Zerg rushing up, the Tengu army responsible for patrolling and alerting suddenly became nervous.

The Zerg did not waste words and came to the battlefield. The hosts' detection capabilities were fully activated, and all the strange things hidden on the battlefield were revealed in the eyes of the Zerg.

Because of the suppression of the Qiyun formation, these strange things cannot exist in any form other than material. Now that they are exposed under the eyes of the Zerg, they are a great resource. The Zerg has a lot of experience in fighting strange things.

The Zerg puppies scattered and pounced on various corpses and objects on the battlefield, launching a fierce attack.

"Woo...!"

There seemed to be a low whimpering sound, and the strange things that existed in various forms were directly physically eliminated by the Zerg.

The Tengu army saw that the Zerg seemed to have the ability to eliminate the strange things on the battlefield, so they stepped aside wisely and let the puppies fight with the invisible beings on the battlefield.

These strange creatures that have infiltrated the Qiyun formation diagram, in addition to their strange shapes and strong concealment, are not actually strong in combat power. They are no match for the Zerg puppies.

As long as they can be seen, an ordinary soldier can defeat them.

Through the host's vision, Wu Qing saw the dense and various forms of strange creatures lurking on the battlefield, which made people feel very uncomfortable. If they are not eliminated as soon as possible, I don't know how many people will die on the battlefield overnight.

Of course, from another perspective, these strange creatures are resources and the source of power for the development of the Zerg.

Whether it is to save people or for resources, Wu Qing can't leave it alone.

There is nothing to consider. Wu Qing ordered the one-star host to return with the Qiyun formation diagram and then lead 20,000 Zerg troops to rush to the battlefield.

The 20,000 Zerg troops entered the battlefield smoothly again. A total of 30,000 Zergs, led by the host, began to kill on the battlefield.

In the eyes of outsiders, the Zerg were destroying everywhere on the battlefield, slashing at corpses, weapon and equipment debris and various items.

If they hadn't seen with their own eyes that those seemingly dead things would unexpectedly counterattack the Zerg, the people of the Tengu clan would definitely think that these Zerg came to the battlefield to cause damage.

Thirty thousand Zergs were like a huge comb, combing the battlefield. No strange events occurred in the places where the Zerg combed.

This shows that the Zerg cleaned up the weird very cleanly, and they could indeed find the real body of the weird on the battlefield.

This allowed the soldiers and logistics personnel who were doing the cleaning work on the battlefield to find a way to work safely. They all consciously moved to the places where the Zerg had combed, and no one dared to go to the places where the Zerg had not arrived.

The Zerg seemed to have become the savior on the battlefield, successfully saving everyone's lives, and it was also considered to make up for the mistakes of the Tengu clan.

Under the Qiyun formation diagram, a large number of deaths would have a very bad impact. Everyone is not a fool and knows what is going on.

The Tengu clan can choose to ignore this loss, but it is unknown what the lords of various clans who experienced all this on the battlefield will think.

The organizers moved to the various lords behind the Zerg, gathered together spontaneously, and began to exchange information.

"Who knows where these troops came from? They are allies in the same camp, but they seem to be at odds with the Tengu clan?"

"Allies are definitely allies. If they hadn't assisted in the daytime battle, we would probably have to continue fighting tomorrow, and we might not win!"

"They really made great contributions to the victory of this battle!"

"I didn't expect them to be able to find the weirdness hidden on the battlefield. The Tengu clan caused such a big accident, but no one came out to take responsibility and preside over the overall situation!"

"Fortunately, this ally rushed over at the risk of helping us eliminate the weirdness, otherwise after tonight, it's hard to say how many people will be left on the battlefield!"

"Family members don't care about their own family members, and they need outsiders to help. This is really...!"

"..."

The surviving lords are all lords of powerful territories within the Tengu clan's sphere of influence. They are a group of people with very close relations with the Tengu clan.

Those lords who had seen the alliance army on the periphery were almost cannon fodder on the battlefield, and all fell on this battlefield.

Now everyone knew nothing about the Independent Territory Alliance and the Zerg, and thought that the Zerg was an ally coming from afar.

"I know them, they are the army of the Independent Territory Alliance, and those who are fighting are the Zerg army!"

A low voice that was as low as possible sounded behind the lords.

Everyone turned around and saw that the speaker was an inconspicuous lord of the cattle tribe.

"Where did you get the news? What kind of alliance is the Independent Territory Alliance?"

A lord asked.

"Last night, their army was stationed in the territory where I was stationed, and I drank with several of their lords!"

The cattle tribe lord said this with a bit of pride.

This cattle tribe lord was Niu Kun that Wu Qing and Meng had been talking about. I didn't expect that he was still alive and was still on this battlefield!

There are many Bull Clan soldiers on the battlefield. Bull Clan soldiers are very popular in various territories, so not only Bull Clan lords have Bull Clan soldiers, but all major territories have Bull Clan soldiers.

For example, the fierce Tiger Territory has a team of Bull Clan soldiers.

When the Zerg entered the battlefield, Wu Qing also paid attention to the Bull Clan people on the battlefield, but he never found Niu Kun. This was a perfect miss.

"Come! Let's talk about the Independent Territory Alliance and the Zerg!"

Many lords immediately became interested and started asking Niu Kun around.

The senior leaders of the Tengu clan are unwilling to come out to take care of things because of problems on the battlefield. The so-called out of sight, out of mind, is what the clan elders do. The people below are following the same example. They are all deaf to what is happening on the battlefield. changes, nothing is known.

The major lords on the battlefield are now doing their own thing, no one cares about their life or death, and they don't care about the generals and troops who directly belong to the Tengu clan.

Now that everyone's safety was guaranteed due to the Zerg, I could finally relax, so I became interested in Niu Kun, the only person present who knew about the Independent Territory Alliance and the Zerg, and kept asking him.

Fortunately, Niu Kun and Meng talked about some things while drinking, otherwise he would have nothing to talk about now.

After learning about the situation of the Independent Territory Alliance and the Zerg from Niu Kun, the major lords present had mixed emotions. They did not expect that the allies who could turn the situation around were actually those independent territories that they had never looked down on before. formed alliance.

Of course, the main role played by the Zerg is the Zerg. They feel sincere admiration for the race that chose to be born in this period when all major races are preparing to escape from the world!
